correctness.rationale: For a weight-zero RB map P on K⊕V with V²=0, compare scalar parts of identities for radical pairs and (1,1) to force image into V over *all* fields (no illicit division by two). Bilinearity reduces the identity exactly to P(a+u)=av+L(u), L²=0, 2Lv=0; direct substitution proves sufficiency. Rank s of square-zero L is ≤r=floor(n/2); the incidence vector bundle over Gr(n-r,V) with imL⊂W⊂kerL, and in odd characteristic v∈W, is smooth irreducible proper and generically birational; dimension 2r(n-r)+n in char2 and (n-r)(2r+1) otherwise, giving excess r. Choosing im/ker and an isomorphism V/ker→im yields Gaussian rank T_{n,s}; vector fibers q^n even and q^{n-s} odd. Independently exhausted all 512 GF2-linear maps for n=2 and found 16 RB maps matching classification; this finite check does not prove all n.
